records.title: Kavalactone profiling of Piper methysticum root and rhizome extracts and the modulation of CYP450 activity in vitro.
records.source_title: Kavalactone profiling of Piper methysticum root and rhizome extracts and the modulation of CYP450 activity in vitro.
records.abstract: Investigators profiled aqueous and ethanol kava extracts and evaluated cytochrome P450 enzyme activity and cell viability in laboratory assays. Extract profiles differed; both extracts inhibited CYP1A2 and CYP3A4 under tested conditions. Flavokavain B was cytotoxic in the tested cells, whereas the whole extracts were not. No human interaction outcome was studied.
